title: Clopidogrel (Plavix)
mechanism: Active metabolite (via CYP2C19) irreversibly blocks the platelet P2Y12 ADP receptor

uses.agent: Clopidogrel + aspirin — minor stroke (NIHSS ≤3) or high-risk TIA (ABCD2 ≥4), no IVT
uses.doseText: Load 300–600 mg, then 75 mg daily with aspirin × 21 days (up to 90), then SAPT
notes: Start within 24 h (Kleindorfer: ideally 12–24 h, at least within 7 days)
CHANCE: 300 mg load, 21 days; POINT: 600 mg load, 90 days (more bleeding)
INSPIRES: up to 72 h with presumed atherosclerotic cause, 21 days (AHA 2026: COR 2a, B-R)
DAPT >90 days: excess hemorrhage (Kleindorfer: COR 3: Harm, A)
Antiplatelet preferred over anticoagulation (AHA 2026 and Kleindorfer 2021: COR 1, A)
Choose agent on risk profile, cost, tolerance (AHA 2026: COR 1, C-EO)
evidenceNote: Kleindorfer 2021: COR 1, LOE A (aspirin 50–325 mg, clopidogrel 75 mg, or aspirin 25 mg/ER-dipyridamole 200 mg BID)

timing.halfLifeText: Parent ~6 h; active metabolite ~30 min; platelet effect lasts the platelet lifespan (7–10 days) (label)
holdBeforeProcedure: Stop 5 days before elective surgery if an antiplatelet effect isn't wanted (label)
thrombolysisRule: Prior SAPT/DAPT doesn't exclude IVT — give if otherwise eligible (AHA 2026 §4.6.1 Rec 9: COR 1, B-NR); sICH +0.9% SAPT / +1.2% DAPT absolute

reversal.agent: Platelet transfusion — ICH without planned surgery
notes: NCS: against, regardless of agent, platelet-function result, volume or exam
evidenceNote: AHA ICH 2022 harm recommendation is for aspirin specifically

reversal.doseText: 1 single-donor apheresis unit; platelet-function testing first if available
notes: Repeat only if platelet function stays abnormal (NCS)
Don't transfuse if platelet function is normal or documented resistance (NCS strong)
evidenceNote: NCS 2016: conditional, moderate quality (aspirin or ADP inhibitor)

notes: Can be combined with platelet transfusion before surgery (NCS)
evidenceNote: AHA ICH 2022: COR 2b, LOE C-LD (effectiveness uncertain)

monitoring: CBC if TTP suspected (thrombocytopenia, anemia with schistocytes, neuro findings, renal dysfunction, fever) (label)
pregnancy: Pregnancy: use for the shortest duration needed; lactation: low infant risk on limited data (Miller 2026)
institutionVaries: CYP2C19 genotype testing availability and turnaround
pearls: Boxed warning: reduced effect in CYP2C19 poor metabolizers — consider another P2Y12 inhibitor (label)
CYP2C19 loss-of-function carriers with minor stroke/TIA: ticagrelor + aspirin × 21 days may be reasonable instead (AHA 2026: COR 2b, B-R)
Without a load, the antiplatelet effect takes several days (label)
Platelet transfusion within 4 h of a load or 2 h of a maintenance dose may be less effective (label)
After IVT: antiplatelets in the first 24 h might be considered only with a compelling indication (AHA 2026: COR 2b, B-NR); usual practice is 24-h imaging first
